Hi Jordan / Karen,

Thanks again for today's checkpoint. Attached is MAP_v3.xlsx (updated timeline + owners) — highlights below and open items we agreed to track before our next sync: 

Summary (Week 3):
- Integration POC: FinCo engineering to share sample S3 keys and read-only test dataset by 2026-06-11 (owner: Jordan).
- Eval cadence: Redwood to run perf eval with 50k tokens/day test harness; first report in 48 hours after test data arrives (owner: Tessa).
- Security questionnaire: FinCo asked for SOC2 attestation and a short answers pack — we’ll provide initial responses by 2026-06-10 (owner: Rafael).
- Procurement: FinCo to share procurement contact and PO window; Redwood will prep contract redlines (owner: Marissa).

Open/Risks:
- Data access delay (risk): If test data arrives > 2026-06-11, eval timeline slides one week.
- Sizing clarity needed: We need clarification on peak throughput to finalize Dedicated sizing.

Action items (owners & due dates):
1) Jordan — share read-only S3 credentials and sample files (due 2026-06-11).
2) Rafael — send SOC2 summary + questionnaire answers (due 2026-06-10).
3) Tessa — kick off eval run and share initial perf report (due 2026-06-13).
4) Marissa — draft contract redlines and pricing summary (due 2026-06-12).

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (timeline & owners).
Next meeting: Tue 2026-06-09 10:00am PT — 30 min checkpoint (agenda: open risks, eval findings, procurement status).

If anything missing from your side before then, flag it here and we'll adjust the MAP.

Best,

Date: Wed, 08 Jun 2026 09:16:10 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Week 3: progress, risks, and next steps (internal)

Team — quick internal sync notes after Jordan's reply: 

1) Security pack: I will compile SOC2 summary + answers to the FinCo questionnaire. Draft planned by EOD 2026-06-10. Need one small item from Engineering: a short paragraph describing sample data handling (who ingest process owner; retention timeline; KV cache behavior). Tessa — can you ask ProdEng to provide 2-3 lines?

2) Sizing recommendation for Jordan's throughput: based on 40 rps sustained / 200 bursts, I recommend starting with 4x A100-equivalent Dedicated workers with autoscale to 8 for bursts; model variant: rw-large-v2 (quantized) for cost-efficiency. Marissa — flag if this changes pricing band.

3) Contract redlines: Marissa, please prioritize 1) payment terms (net 45 vs our standard net 30), 2) data residency clause, 3) SLA window for Dedicated latency. I can support with technical wording on fallbacks and caching behavior.

I'll attach the questionnaire answers when ready.

-Rafael
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Subject: MAP Recap & Decisions — action owners and next week's agenda

Jordan / Karen — thanks for the quick turnaround this week. Below is the concise recap from the MAP checkpoint and decisions we confirmed. Please let us know if anything needs correcting.

Decisions made:
- Security deliverables: Redwood will provide SOC2 summary + questionnaire responses by 2026-06-10 (owner: Rafael).
- Test data: FinCo to deliver sample S3 access and 10GB sample by 2026-06-11 (owner: Jordan / Karen).
- Eval run: Redwood to begin perf eval within 24 hrs of receiving sample and deliver first report by 2026-06-13 (owner: Tessa).
- Sizing & pricing: Start with 4 Dedicated workers (rw-large-v2, quantized) with autoscale to 8 for bursts; pricing summary and contract redlines delivered by 2026-06-12 (owner: Marissa).
- Procurement timing: FinCo aiming for PO by 2026-06-30; Redwood to prepare contract and be ready for DocuSign (owner: Marissa / Michael).

Updated risk register:
- If sample data misses 6/11 deadline => eval shifts one week and PO may slide. (Mitigation: Redwood will run a small synthetic eval to provide early performance signals if needed).
- If security review needs penetration test => add 2 weeks to onboarding timeline. (Mitigation: provide SOC2 artifacts & a short data handling note to reduce likelihood).

Attachments provided: MAP_v3.xlsx (current owners & dates), security_questionnaire_responses.pdf (initial responses).

Action summary (owner — due):
- Rafael — SOC2 summary + questionnaire (2026-06-10) [attachment].
- Jordan / Karen — sample S3 + creds (2026-06-11).
- Tessa — run eval and share report (2026-06-13).
- Marissa — contract redlines + pricing summary (2026-06-12).
- Michael — standby for DocuSign when PO arrives (2026-06-30).

Next meeting (confirmed): Tue 2026-06-16 10:00am PT — 30 min. Draft agenda: 1) Perf report review, 2) Procurement update, 3) Finalize pilot onboarding checklist.
